near_misses.title: Colourful sunset likely tomorrow 4:30pm
near_misses.body: 16% odds of colour. Best bets: Maryhill Loops Road (switchbacks), Maryhill Museum of Art grounds, Trout Lake valley. Horizon toward the sun is 17% open.
why: 41% chance of a colourful sunset sky (HRRR: mid/high cloud 20–80%, low cloud under 40%)
also checks for a low cloud deck between you and the sun
path toward the setting sun 17% open (25–300 km)
